body.name: \(\mathcal E(P_X)\)
body.def: for each observed coordinate \(j\), labels \(\ell,\ell'\in\mathscr L(P_X)\) satisfy \(\ell\mathrel{E_j}\ell'\) exactly when the recovered conditional distributions of \(X_j\) in components \(\ell\) and \(\ell'\) coincide
body.role: observable component-equality pattern used for coordinate alignment
